title: EDW Migration Copilot
description: Ask natural-language questions about the EDW migration run (agent events, backlog, conversions, reconcile results) and the migrated WideWorldImportersDW gold marts. Deployed by databricks/genie/create_genie_space.sh.

question: Why did the last migration run fail the gate?
Which legacy stored procedures have been converted, and where did the output land?
How many events did each agent emit in the latest run?
Top 10 stock items by gross revenue?
How many current customers are there per country?
What is the available stock by brand?

content:
This space covers two domains of an EDW-to-Databricks migration demo. (1) Migration operations: the ops schema records one agent-driven migration run — edw_migration.ops.agent_events (hook telemetry), ops.migration_backlog (procs to migrate), ops.proc_conversion_map (converted procs), ops.reconcile_results (correctness checks). (2) Migrated analytics: the gold schema holds WideWorldImportersDW marts produced by the medallion pipeline.

Vocabulary: a 'run' is one migration run identified by run_id. The 'gate' is the deterministic ship/no-ship decision at the end of a run. A 'blocker' is a condition that fails the gate: a reconcile check with result = 'fail', or a backlog proc with no converted artifact. 'Convert' means translating a legacy Integration.* T-SQL stored procedure into a Databricks SQL file (target_path, usually under databricks/converted/).

ops.agent_events.agent is one of: coordinator, assess, convert, test, gate. event holds Cursor hook names such as subagentStart, subagentStop, afterFileEdit, afterShellExecution, afterMCPExecution. When a question does not name a run, use the most recent run (the run_id with the greatest ts).

Route analytics questions to the right gold mart: revenue/profit/sales trends -> edw_migration.gold.mart_daily_internet_sales (grain: sale_date x stock item; measures quantity_sold, gross_revenue, profit, transaction_count). Customers -> gold.mart_customer_current (current SCD2 records only; joins to gold.mart_city_dimension on city_id for geography). Inventory -> gold.mart_stock_movements (quantity_on_hand, quantity_allocated, quantity_available per stock item with brand and size).

question: Why did the last migration run fail the gate?
sql: SELECT check_id, table_name, expected, actual, delta FROM edw_migration.ops.reconcile_results WHERE result = 'fail' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20
usage_guidance: Failed reconcile checks are the gate blockers. Pair with proc_conversion_map gaps (backlog procs with no draft/review/final row) for the full blocker list.

question: Which legacy stored procedures have been converted, and where did the output land?
sql: SELECT legacy_proc, target_path, status, updated_at FROM edw_migration.ops.proc_conversion_map ORDER BY legacy_proc
usage_guidance: status is draft, review, or final. Compare against ops.migration_backlog for procs still pending.

question: How many events did each agent emit in the latest run?
sql: SELECT agent, COUNT(*) AS events FROM edw_migration.ops.agent_events WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM edw_migration.ops.agent_events ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY agent ORDER BY events DESC
usage_guidance: A complete run shows events from coordinator, assess, convert, test, and gate; a missing agent means the run did not finish.

question: Top 10 stock items by gross revenue?
sql: SELECT stock_item_name, SUM(gross_revenue) AS gross_revenue, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(quantity_sold) AS quantity_sold FROM edw_migration.gold.mart_daily_internet_sales GROUP BY stock_item_name ORDER BY gross_revenue DESC LIMIT 10
usage_guidance: Add a sale_date filter for time-boxed questions.

question: How many current customers are there per country?
sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM edw_migration.gold.mart_customer_current GROUP BY country ORDER BY customers DESC
usage_guidance: mart_customer_current holds only current SCD2 records; state_province and city_name are available for finer geography.

question: What is the available stock by brand?
sql: SELECT brand, SUM(quantity_on_hand) AS on_hand, SUM(quantity_allocated) AS allocated, SUM(quantity_available) AS available FROM edw_migration.gold.mart_stock_movements GROUP BY brand ORDER BY available DESC
usage_guidance: quantity_available = on hand minus allocated; rows with NULL brand are unbranded items.
